Need-Based Fee Waiver
Need-based fee waivers eligibility requirements differ for currently enrolled applicants and applicants that are not enrolled.  If you are interested in applying for a need-based fee waiver, please answer the following question.
Are you currently enrolled in a college or university?
Fee Waiver for Enrolled Applicants

Waivers of UCLA's application fee are available for U.S. citizens, Permanent Residents and others who meet the following criteria:

Are currently enrolled in a college or university

and

Are receiving need-based financial aid (if not US citizen or Permanent Resident then you must be receiving financial aid from the state of California)

and

Submit a statement from the Financial Aid officer at the school where they are enrolled confirming all of the above and stating that payment of UCLA's application fee would be a financial hardship.

Applicants who are eligible under these criteria for a need-based fee waiver should select the appropriate option below, upload the statement from their Financial Aid officer and submit the application.

The statement may be sent separately, but please note that a decision cannot be made on the application until UCLA receives confirmation of eligibility. If you are not able to upload the statement here, please send it directly to the program to which you are applying  as soon as possible. Be sure your full name and date of birth are included in the Financial Aid officer's statement.

Please note that income tax returns, unemployment documents, copies of your FAFSA, Expected Family Contribution or other financial estimates cannot be accepted as documentation of eligibility for a fee waiver.
Fee Waiver for Applicants Not Enrolled

Waivers of UCLA's application fee are available for U.S. citizens, Permanent Residents and others who have financial need as determined by the Adjusted Gross Income (AGI) on their United States tax return. To be eligible applicants annual family income cannot exceed the maximum AGI listed in the Family Income Guidelines chart below:
 
FAMILY SIZE
(including student)		FAMILY INCOME
(Maximum Adjusted Gross Income on Tax Return)
1 person in household$29,526
2 persons in household$40,034
3 persons in household$50,542
4 persons in household$61,050
5 persons in household$71,558
For each additional family memberadd $10,508

Required Documentation to Demonstrate Financial Need

To demonstrate financial need redact/block out the Social Security number wherever it appears, and upload the following:
A copy of your 2025 Federal Income Tax Return - Form 1040 ONLY.

Don't include schedules and supporting documents!

Provide either your own Form 1040, if you are independent, or a copy of your parent’s or guardian’s 2025 Federal Income Tax return - Form 1040, if you are listed as a dependent. 
Please note: Unemployment documents, W2 forms, copies of your FAFSA, Expected Family Contribution or other financial estimates cannot be accepted as documentation of eligibility for a fee waiver.

Upload a copy of your 2025 Federal Income Tax Return - Form 1040 ONLY.

Make sure you redact all Social Security numbers before submitting the documents.

Benefits-Based Fee Waiver
Benefits-based fee waivers are for applicants who may be experiencing financial hardship at the time of application. Applicants must submit a benefits stub from their local municipality showing proof of receiving aid dated within the last 90 days. 
Make sure you redact any personally identifiable information (Social Security number, Medical information, Health insurance policy number or subscriber ID, Driver's license number or state ID, etc.) before submitting documents.
